repo.name: apple-mail-todoist
primary_users: macOS professionals using Apple Mail and Todoist
maintainers and AI agents implementing local automation

vision.one_line: Create one traceable Todoist task from a selected Apple Mail message without leaving or changing Mail.
vision.north_star: A person can select a message, invoke one command, receive a trustworthy Todoist task and quiet confirmation in under three seconds, then continue working in Mail.
vision.promise: One keystroke creates exactly one actionable task with a working link back to the source message, while credentials and correspondence remain private.
vision.wedge: A Raycast command on macOS that reads one Mail selection, sends explicit fields through the official Todoist CLI, protects against duplicate delivery, and reports the outcome without blocking Raycast.
target_users: People who process correspondence in Apple Mail and commitments in Todoist
Privacy-conscious automation maintainers who need locally testable boundaries

principles.title: Agent-first repository surface
principles.rule: A fresh agent can discover product intent, safety constraints, ordered work, and proof commands from committed machine-readable contracts.
good: The repo-local Go contract and JSON design vision route the next bounded task
bad: Critical implementation intent depends on an unavailable conversation transcript

principles.title: One-keystroke default
principles.rule: The primary command creates the task directly with deterministic defaults and does not interrupt the Mail workflow with a form or navigation.
good: A short Raycast HUD confirms success while focus remains in Apple Mail
bad: Opening Todoist or requiring a confirmation dialog for every normal capture

principles.title: Apple Mail is read-only
principles.rule: The product may inspect the current selection but never archive, move, flag, delete, send, or modify mail.
good: The JXA adapter exposes selection reads through a narrow port
bad: Task success automatically archives the source message

principles.title: Minimize correspondence data
principles.rule: Read and retain only fields needed for the deterministic task; exclude bodies and attachments from the default product.
good: Task composition uses subject, sender display, received time, and RFC Message-ID
bad: Exporting a complete EML to build a simple Todoist task

principles.title: Authentication belongs to Todoist
principles.rule: The official Todoist CLI owns browser OAuth and OS credential storage; this application never retrieves or accepts the credential.
good: td auth login authorizes once through the browser and secure OS store
bad: A manually copied token in an application command, environment example, or repository file

principles.title: One source, one external effect
principles.rule: Stable request identity and minimal local state prevent retries or ambiguous responses from creating duplicate Todoist tasks.
good: A timeout produces reconciliation-needed state before another POST is permitted
bad: Blindly retrying task creation after any network exception

principles.title: Confirm only known outcomes
principles.rule: HUD messages distinguish confirmed creation, existing task, safe failure, and uncertain delivery.
good: Todoist task created appears only after a validated API response
bad: Showing success when the network result is unknown

principles.title: Test side effects behind ports
principles.rule: Mail, the Todoist CLI, local state, and feedback behavior remain replaceable boundaries around a pure orchestration core.
good: The full default suite runs with fake adapters and no macOS app access
bad: Tests require a personal Mail mailbox or Todoist account

principles.title: Machine-readable contracts first
principles.rule: Vision, workflow state, task acceptance, and structured adapter outcomes are JSON or JSONL; Markdown explains them without becoming canonical state.
good: A fresh agent validates docs/vision.json and .go before claiming work
bad: A critical retry rule exists only in a prose roadmap

principles.title: Public-safe by default
principles.rule: Repository files and history use synthetic identities and exclude credentials, live mail, local databases, logs, and private screenshots.
good: Fixtures use example.invalid and fabricated Message-IDs
bad: A real selected message is committed as integration evidence

principles.title: Missing proof is not success
principles.rule: Invalid selection, missing Message-ID, credential failure, malformed API responses, and unresolved delivery uncertainty stop safely with a typed outcome.
good: An unsupported message produces guidance without creating a partial task
bad: Synthesizing a deep link from unstable local fields

non_goals: Save or enrich messages in JSONL Vault.
Archive, move, flag, delete, send, or otherwise manage email.
Read message bodies or attachments in the default capture.
Infer dates, projects, priorities, or summaries with AI.
Provide background inbox monitoring, multi-message batches, or cross-platform email clients.
assumptions: Apple Mail continues to expose selection metadata and RFC Message-ID through macOS automation.
The message URL resolves a locally indexed message after mailbox moves on the same Mac.
Todoist preserves and activates a percent-encoded Apple Mail link in a task description on macOS.
The official Todoist CLI continues to support browser OAuth, structured task creation, and JSON output.
A default Inbox task with a mail label is useful enough to keep the primary command dialog-free.
Minimal local reconciliation state is acceptable when it excludes mail text and credentials.

forbidden: Todoist tokens, authorization headers, macOS Keychain exports, or credential examples
Real email addresses, subjects, message bodies, attachments, or RFC Message-IDs
Exported EML, mailbox archives, private screenshots, logs, or API response captures
Local reconciliation databases, generated runtime state, or application-support state
Automation code that mutates Apple Mail in the task-capture path
required_boundaries: Use synthetic example.invalid identities in repository artifacts
Delegate OAuth and credential storage to the official Todoist CLI without retrieving its token
Redact secrets and correspondence from exceptions, logs, HUD text, and evidence
Reconcile uncertain delivery before replaying a Todoist mutation
Keep live integration checks explicit, local, disposable, and untracked
Fail closed when the selected message cannot produce a stable deep link
public_safety.privacy_posture: The public repository contains code and synthetic contracts only. Live correspondence and task-delivery state remain on the user's Mac under least-privilege file permissions and documented retention controls.

acceptance_scorecard.question: Do durable machine-facing artifacts validate against committed contracts?
acceptance_scorecard.pass_condition: make check validates docs/vision.json, .go state, Python metadata, and task references.

acceptance_scorecard.question: Does one invocation create no more than one logical Todoist task?
acceptance_scorecard.pass_condition: Success, timeout, replay, and uncertain-response tests prove stable request identity and reconciliation.

acceptance_scorecard.question: Can task capture complete without mutating Apple Mail?
acceptance_scorecard.pass_condition: The production adapter contains only selection reads and a live proof confirms unchanged message state.

acceptance_scorecard.question: Does the Todoist description open the exact selected message on macOS?
acceptance_scorecard.pass_condition: Synthetic encoding tests pass and a redacted manual proof covers Mail-to-Todoist-to-Mail navigation.

acceptance_scorecard.question: Can the workflow operate without exposing the Todoist token?
acceptance_scorecard.pass_condition: Todoist CLI adapter tests and repository scans show no token retrieval, token argument, tracked credential, log disclosure, or secret fixture.

acceptance_scorecard.question: Does the normal path confirm success without breaking focus?
acceptance_scorecard.pass_condition: A Raycast HUD reports a confirmed outcome and the active workflow remains in Apple Mail.

acceptance_scorecard.question: Can a new developer or agent understand and validate the repository from a clean clone?
acceptance_scorecard.pass_condition: The documented uv setup and make check complete without private services or data.

acceptance_scorecard.question: Are the current tree and Git history safe to publish?
acceptance_scorecard.pass_condition: Automated and manual scans find no credentials, private mail, runtime state, private screenshots, or unreviewed large binaries.

review_checklist: Confirm Apple Mail access remains read-only and narrowly scoped to the current selection.
Confirm the default path excludes mail bodies and attachments.
Confirm the official Todoist CLI owns credentials and this application redacts every output path.
Confirm stable request identity survives timeout, crash, replay, and HUD failure.
Confirm uncertain delivery reconciles before another Todoist POST.
Confirm task defaults remain explicit and do not infer dates, projects, priorities, or summaries.
Confirm deep-link encoding adds angle brackets once and percent-encodes the complete payload.
Confirm tests and documentation contain only synthetic identities.
Confirm all behavior claims have reproducible evidence and residual risk is stated.
Confirm make check passes from a fresh clone without live Apple Mail or Todoist access.

maturity_model.meaning: Public identity, vision, architecture, safety, local validation, and implementation tasks are coherent and released.
Synthetic encoding and a redacted macOS check prove that Todoist preserves a working Apple Mail deep link.
Mail, Todoist CLI, and reconciliation adapters satisfy the full fake-port contract suite.
The Raycast command completes the official CLI flow with immediate HUD feedback, final notification, and redacted live evidence.

residual_risk_wording: A green local suite cannot guarantee that macOS automation permissions, Apple Mail URL handling, Raycast behavior, or Todoist API behavior remain unchanged; each product release must include a bounded redacted live check.
